releaseNotes: Crash-safe expense and payment detail rendering, including offline and dummy members.
Role- and status-aware expense/payment actions with edit and soft-deletion controls.
Expenses and payments can be removed from active totals with ledger reversals and retained audit history.
Permanent trip deletion for trip creators, with dependent financial records removed transactionally.
Pending payment editing; confirmed, disputed, and cancelled payments remain immutable.
Conditional trip actions now follow trip lifecycle and active membership state.
Trip dashboard total spent now uses the backend totalSpentPaise contract.
Improved transaction limits and database write batching for remote MySQL reliability.
